run_MLP_benchmark: run a PyTorch MLP performance benchmark on CPU, GPU, or TPU with configurable layers and batch size
train_Net_model: train a multi-layer neural network with linear layers, ReLU activations, and softmax output using SGD or Adagrad
train_gpu_with_autocast: train a GPU model using torch.cuda.amp autocast for mixed precision float16 or bfloat16 training
train_gpu_with_explicit_cast: train a GPU model by explicitly casting model weights and data to float16 or bfloat16 dtype
run_single_training: run a single training configuration with specified layer sizes, batch size, device, and data type settings
